sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 在2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 接着，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是罪案档案呈现的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本期节目最初发布于罪案档案的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium频道，作为给付费订阅者的早期福利。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些节目的设计略微简短，使我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 要提前且无广告地收听这些节目，您可以在您喜爱的平台上支持罪案档案。

sentences.en: Growing up in the English city of Bradford, Samia Shahid was a typical high-spirited girl.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅·沙希德在英国城市布拉德福德长大，是一个典型的性格活泼的女孩。

sentences.en: She enjoyed fashion and fast cars, and was popular, funny, and headstrong.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢时尚和跑车，人缘很好、风趣且固执己见。

sentences.en: Samia's family fully supported her endeavours, especially her father, Mohamed.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的家人全力支持她的努力，尤其是她的父亲穆罕默德。

sentences.en: There was no question that Samia was a daddy's girl.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，萨米娅是个爸爸的小宝贝。

sentences.en: The Shahid family were well-known around Bradford.
sentences.zh: 沙希德一家在布拉德福德远近闻名。

sentences.en: Samia's parents ran a limousine and car service business.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的父母经营着一家豪华轿车和汽车服务公司。

sentences.en: One of her uncles owned a fish-and-chip shop, and another, the local floriSt.
sentences.zh: 她的一个叔叔拥有一家炸鱼薯条店，另一个叔叔则是当地的花店老板。

sentences.en: The Shahid family tree also extended to their ancestral home of Pandori, a small village in the Punjab region of Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 沙希德家族的族谱还延伸到了他们的祖籍地潘多里，那是巴基斯坦旁遮普地区的一个小村庄。

sentences.en: Samia and her younger sister, Madiha, were given latitude to enjoy their Western upbringing, though only up to a point.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅和她的妹妹马迪哈被给予了享受西方成长环境的自由，尽管这也有一定的限度。

sentences.en: The Shahids remained true to their Sunni Muslim faith and Pakistani heritage.
sentences.zh: 沙希德一家依然坚守着他们的逊尼派穆斯林信仰和巴基斯坦传统。

sentences.en: In 2012, as Samia reached her mid-twenties, her parents felt it was time for her to settle down and marry.
sentences.zh: 2012年，正值萨米娅二十岁出头之际，她的父母觉得是时候让她安定下来并结婚了。

sentences.en: Although arranged marriages weren't required by the Sunni faith, they were encouraged, if not expected, through Pakistani tradition.
sentences.zh: 尽管逊尼派信仰并未强制要求包办婚姻，但巴基斯坦传统却对此极力鼓励，甚至可以说是顺理成章。

sentences.en: Samia wanted to make her family happy and proud, and was open to the idea.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅希望让家人感到幸福和骄傲，并且对这个想法持开放态度。

sentences.en: Muhammad Shahid chose a man named Chaudhry Shaqeel to be his daughter's husband.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·沙希德选择了一个名叫乔杜里·沙基尔的男子作为他女儿的丈夫。

sentences.en: Samia was less than enthused.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅一点也高兴不起来。

sentences.en: Shaqeel lived in Pandori and had just been released from prison for a non-fatal shooting of another man over a land dispute.
sentences.zh: 沙基尔住在潘多里，刚因土地纠纷非致命枪击另一名男子而刑满释放。

sentences.en: He was also Samia's first cousin.
sentences.zh: 他也是萨米娅的表哥。

sentences.en: Marriages between first cousins in the British-Pakistani community weren't uncommon.
sentences.zh: 在英籍巴基斯坦族群中，表亲之间的婚姻并不少见。

sentences.en: Samia's parents were first cousins and had an enduring and loving marriage.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的父母就是表兄妹，并且拥有持久而美满的婚姻。

sentences.en: They just wanted what they thought was best for their daughter.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想要他们认为对女儿最好的东西。

sentences.en: Samia put on a happy face around her family and appeared willing to give her upcoming marriage her best shot.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅在家人面前强颜欢笑，并表现出愿意为即将到来的婚姻全力以赴的姿态。

sentences.en: Plans were made for her to travel to Pakistan for the wedding.
sentences.zh: 相关计划已经制定，安排她前往巴基斯坦完婚。

sentences.en: Though, when speaking with her friends, Samia was plagued with concerns.
sentences.zh: 然而，当与朋友交谈时，萨米娅却被各种担忧所困扰。

sentences.en: She sought to live a happy life, but couldn't see this happening with the Chaudhry Shaqeel.
sentences.zh: 她渴望过上幸福的生活，但觉得和乔杜里·沙基尔在一起根本不可能实现这一点。

sentences.en: In the weeks leading up to her departure, Samia sent multiple messages to her friends expressing her growing despair.
sentences.zh: 在她出发前的几周里，萨米娅给朋友们发送了多条信息，表达了她日益加深的绝望。

sentences.en: In one, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 她在其中一条中写道：

sentences.en: I'm dying, I swear.
sentences.zh: 我快死了，我发誓。

sentences.en: My life's a joke.
sentences.zh: 我的生活简直是个笑话。

sentences.en: Samia arrived in Pakistan in mid-February 2012.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅于2012年2月中旬抵达巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: Determined not to upset her family, she threw herself into the task of planning her wedding.
sentences.zh: 为了不让家人心烦，她全身心地投入到婚礼筹备工作中。

sentences.en: She bought her outfit and jewellery from the Pakistani bazaar and fine-tuned every detail of the event.
sentences.zh: 她从巴基斯坦集市上购买了服装和首饰，并精益求精地打理活动的每一个细节。

sentences.en: Her father paid for everything she needed.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲为她所需的一切买单。

sentences.en: Samia wed Chaudhry Shaqeel in a four-day ceremony in front of hundreds of guests.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅在一场为期四天、有数百名宾客见证的仪式上嫁给了乔杜里·沙基尔。

sentences.en: As a wedding gift to his new son-in-law, Samia's father gave Shaqeel the house next door to the
sentences.zh: 作为送给新女婿的结婚礼物，萨米娅的父亲把沙基尔安排在潘多里

sentences.en: Shahid family home in Pandori.
sentences.zh: 沙希德家族住宅隔壁的房子里。

sentences.en: After the wedding, Samia and Shaqeel moved in.
sentences.zh: 婚礼结束后，萨米娅和沙基尔搬了进去。

sentences.en: Four months later, in June, Samia returned to Bradford without her new husband.
sentences.zh: 四个月后的六月，萨米娅在没有新婚丈夫陪同的情况下回到了布拉德福德。

sentences.en: Shaqeel intended to migrate to the UK, so Samia assisted with his application for a spousal visa.
sentences.zh: 沙基尔打算移民英国，因此萨米娅协助他申请了配偶签证。

sentences.en: Their marriage ceremony, known as a niqa under Islam, was in accordance with Pakistan's Sharia law.
sentences.zh: 他们的婚礼在伊斯兰教中被称为尼卡，符合巴基斯坦的沙里亚法。

sentences.en: It therefore qualified as a legally recognised marriage under British law.
sentences.zh: 因此，它在英国法律下符合具有法律效力的婚姻资格。

sentences.en: However, Samia's friends noted that she was a shell of her former self.
sentences.zh: 然而，萨米娅的朋友们注意到她已经失去了往日的精气神。

sentences.en: Although Shaqeel was nearly 4,000 miles away, Samia felt like she was under his constant surveillance.
sentences.zh: 尽管沙基尔远在近四千英里之外，萨米娅却觉得仿佛一直受到他的监视。

sentences.en: He insisted that they video call and remain in contact every day.
sentences.zh: 他坚持要求他们每天进行视频通话并保持联系。

sentences.en: Samia felt trapped and soon fell into depression.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅感到被困住了，不久便陷入了抑郁。

sentences.en: Within a matter of weeks, she told her friends that she wanted to die.
sentences.zh: 短短几周内，她告诉朋友们她想死。

sentences.en: With her husband's visa application still being processed, Samia returned to Pakistan in December.
sentences.zh: 随着她丈夫的签证申请仍在处理中，萨米娅于12月返回巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: She continued living with Shaqeel, but her feelings towards him didn't change.
sentences.zh: 她继续和沙基尔生活在一起，但她对他的感觉没有任何改变。

sentences.en: Six months later, Samia flew back to England.
sentences.zh: 六个月后，萨米娅飞回了英国。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before her friends began to notice a positive change.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，她的朋友们就开始注意到她发生了积极的变化。

sentences.en: Samia seemed more like her former self.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅看起来更像以前的自己了。

sentences.en: She was once again talkative, sociable and cheerful.
sentences.zh: 她再次变得健谈、社交且开朗。

sentences.en: She soon revealed her reason for this.
sentences.zh: 她很快透露了其中的原因。

sentences.en: In October, Samia was out to dinner in London with a group of friends when she met a man named Syed Mugtar Qasim, known as Ali.
sentences.zh: 十月份，萨米娅在伦敦与一群朋友外出吃晚餐时，遇到了一位名叫赛义德·穆格塔尔·卡西姆的男子，大家都叫他阿里。
zh_words: 赛义德·穆格塔尔·卡西姆

sentences.en: Ali had only been visiting London for a short time.
sentences.zh: 阿里当时只在伦敦短暂停留。

sentences.en: He was also a dual British and Pakistani national, but he lived and worked in Dubai.
sentences.zh: 他也是英国和巴基斯坦双重国籍，但在迪拜生活和工作。

sentences.en: Ali and Samia remained in contact and formed a close platonic friendship, opening up about all aspects of their lives, including Samia's unwanted marriage.
sentences.zh: 阿里和萨米娅保持着联系，并建立了深厚的纯洁友谊，向对方倾诉生活的方方面面，包括萨米娅那段不想要的婚姻。

sentences.en: Ali and Samia's feelings for one another developed into a romance, and by 2014, they were in love.
sentences.zh: 阿里和萨米娅对彼此的感情发展成了浪漫恋情，到2014年时，他们已经坠入爱河。

sentences.en: Around the same time, Samia's husband's UK visa application was rejected.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，萨米娅丈夫的英国签证申请被拒绝了。

sentences.en: Consequently, Samia knew that her family would expect her to spend much more of her time in Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 因此，萨米娅知道她的家人会期望她在巴基斯坦呆更多的时间。

sentences.en: She didn't want this life for herself.
sentences.zh: 她不想过这样的生活。

sentences.en: Hoping that Shaquille would accept the futility of their marriage, Samia asked him for a divorce.
sentences.zh: 怀着沙基尔能够接受他们婚姻徒劳无功的希望，萨米娅向他提出了离婚。

sentences.en: He refused.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了。

sentences.en: Samia turned to the protection of Islam.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅转向伊斯兰教寻求保护。

sentences.en: Under Sharia law, a marriage is valid only if both parties give their free consent.
sentences.zh: 根据沙里亚法，只有在双方自愿的情况下婚姻才有效。

sentences.en: This must come without any physical, psychological, financial, or emotional pressure.
sentences.zh: 这必须是在没有任何身体、心理、经济或情感压力的前提下进行的。

sentences.en: Otherwise, the marriage can be considered to be forced and declared void.
sentences.zh: 否则，婚姻可被视为强迫婚姻并被宣布无效。

sentences.en: Samia visited a Bradford mosque and spoke with the prayer leader, also referred to as the imam.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅拜访了布拉德福德的一座清真寺，并与祈祷领袖（也称为伊玛目）交谈。

sentences.en: She revealed that she'd been pressured into marriage by her family.
sentences.zh: 她透露自己受到家人的强迫才结了婚。

sentences.en: The imam attempted to contact Chaudhry Shaquille for his side of the story, but he never responded.
sentences.zh: 伊玛目试图联系乔杜里·沙基尔听取他的说法，但他从未回应。

sentences.en: As a result, Samia's marriage to Shaquille was declared void.
sentences.zh: 因此，萨米娅与沙基尔的婚姻被宣布无效。

sentences.en: Samia kept this news from her family and discreetly began planning a future with Ali.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅对家人隐瞒了这个消息，并开始秘密地规划与阿里的未来。

sentences.en: A little over four months later, the pair wedded.
sentences.zh: 四个多月后，两人结为连理。

sentences.en: They presented themselves at the home of the Bradford-based imam who voided Samia's previous marriage.
sentences.zh: 他们来到了宣布萨米娅上一段婚姻无效的布拉德福德伊玛目的家中。

sentences.en: Samia was happy, smiling and singing throughout the ceremony.
sentences.zh: 整个仪式过程中，萨米娅都沉浸在幸福、微笑和歌声中。

sentences.en: Seventeen days later, the newlyweds completed the British legal formalities by signing the marriage register.
sentences.zh: 十七天后，这对新婚夫妇签署了结婚登记册，完成了英国的法律手续。

sentences.en: Ali soon had to travel back to his home in Dubai for work.
sentences.zh: 阿里很快不得不返回迪拜的家中工作。

sentences.en: Samia had to wait for her spousal visa application to be approved before she could join him.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅必须等待她的配偶签证申请获得批准，才能去和她团聚。

sentences.en: In the meantime, she remained in Bradford with her family, whom she believed were unaware of what she had done.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，她和家人一起留在布拉德福德，她以为家人并不知道她所做的一切。

sentences.en: Just over a month after her marriage to Ali, Samia was walking through town one night when a man approached.
sentences.zh: 就在她与阿里结婚一个多月后的一天晚上，萨米娅正走在镇上，一个男人走了过来。

sentences.en: He wheeled at a metal bar, which she smashed across Samia's legs.
sentences.zh: 他转动着一根金属棒，猛烈地砸向萨米娅的腿部。

sentences.en: By the time Samia was taken to hospital, large red and purple bruises had formed across her thighs.
sentences.zh: 当萨米娅被送到医院时，她的大腿上已经布满了大片红紫色的淤青。

sentences.en: She understood that the secret about her marriage to Ali was out.
sentences.zh: 她明白，她与阿里结婚的秘密已经泄露。

sentences.en: The attack on her was an act of retribution.
sentences.zh: 对她的袭击是一种报复行为。

sentences.en: At the same time, the imam who officiated Samia and Ali's wedding was warned that there would be consequences for his involvement.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，为主持萨米娅和阿里婚礼的伊玛目发出警告，称他将为自己的参与承担后果。

sentences.en: The threats had arisen from the Shahids, Samia's own family.
sentences.zh: 这些威胁来自萨米娅的亲生家人沙希德家族。

sentences.en: Over the coming months, they ostracised Samia further, with her mother throwing out all of her belongings.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几个月里，他们进一步排挤萨米娅，她的母亲甚至扔掉了她所有的东西。

sentences.en: The Shahid family also began threatening Ali, demanding he cut ties with Samia.
sentences.zh: 沙希德家族还开始威胁阿里，要求他切断与萨米娅的联系。

sentences.en: The police were informed and acted accordingly, but the animosity between Samia and her family continued to grow.
sentences.zh: 警方得到了报案并采取了相应行动，但萨米娅与家人之间的敌意仍在不断升级。

sentences.en: She became more frightened for her safety.
sentences.zh: 她对自身安全的恐惧与日俱增。

sentences.en: In late May 2015, eight months after her wedding to Ali, Samia received her spousal visa.
sentences.zh: 2015年5月下旬，即她与阿里结婚八个月后，萨米娅收到了她的配偶签证。

sentences.en: She fled to Dubai the very next day.
sentences.zh: 她第二天就逃往了迪拜。

sentences.en: Samia's happiness was evident in photos and updates she sent back to her friends in the UK.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的幸福从她发回英国朋友的照片和动态中清晰可见。

sentences.en: Yet, the absence of her family weighed heavily on Samia.
sentences.zh: 然而，失去家人的痛苦依然沉重地压在萨米娅心头。

sentences.en: She reached out to her family nearly every day, asking for forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 她几乎每天都联系家人，请求他们的原谅。

sentences.en: While Samia's mother and sister sometimes responded to her messages, her father ignored her completely.
sentences.zh: 虽然萨米娅的母亲和妹妹有时会回复她的信息，但她的父亲却完全不理睬她。

sentences.en: His silence hurt Samia profoundly.
sentences.zh: 他的沉默深深地伤害了萨米娅。

sentences.en: When Ali tried to appeal to Muhammad Shahid, he just demanded that Ali end the marriage to his daughter.
sentences.zh: 当阿里试图向穆罕默德·沙希德求情时，对方只是要求阿里解除与他女儿的婚姻。

sentences.en: Ali refused.
sentences.zh: 阿里拒绝了。

sentences.en: Samia and Ali wanted to have children.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅和阿里想要孩子。

sentences.en: With this in mind, Samia returned to Bradford to extend the olive branch to her family.
sentences.zh: 带着这个想法，萨米娅回到了布拉德福德，向家人抛出了橄榄枝。

sentences.en: Her mother collected her from the airport and brought her home to see her father and sister.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲去机场接她回家看望父亲和妹妹。

sentences.en: Samia kissed her dad and begged him for forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅吻了父亲，并恳求他的原谅。

sentences.en: Everyone was in tears, and for a fleeting moment, Samia hoped that she would be welcomed back.
sentences.zh: 所有人都泪流满面，在短暂的一瞬间，萨米娅希望自己能被接纳回家。

sentences.en: However, the Pakistani traditions of family reputation and respect were deeply upheld by Muhammad Shahid and his extended family.
sentences.zh: 然而，穆罕默德·沙希德及其家族对家庭声誉和尊严的巴基斯坦传统深信不疑。

sentences.en: In their eyes, Samia had brought great shame on the family by marrying Ali.
sentences.zh: 在他们眼里，萨米娅嫁给阿里给家族带来了极大的耻辱。

sentences.en: Not only was he from outside the family, he wasn't even a member of the same faith.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是个外人，甚至都不是同一个信仰的人。

sentences.en: Samia's family were Sunni Muslims, whereas Ali and his family were Shia MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的家人是逊尼派穆斯林，而阿里和他的家人则是什叶派穆斯林。

sentences.en: A bitter and violent split dating back 14 centuries exists between the Sunnis and the Shi'as over who should succeed the Prophet Muhammad as the leader of the Islamic faith.
sentences.zh: 逊尼派和什叶派之间长达14个世纪的惨烈血腥分裂，源于谁应当继承先知穆罕默德作为伊斯兰教领袖。

sentences.en: In another perceived slight to her family, Samia had converted to the Shia Muslim faith prior to marrying Ali.
sentences.zh: 在家人看来这是又一次冒犯，萨米娅在嫁给阿里之前改信了什叶派穆斯林。

sentences.en: Muhammad Shahid outright rejected his daughter.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·沙希德彻底断绝了与女儿的关系。

sentences.en: In a voice message left for Ali, Samia said,
sentences.zh: 在留给阿里的语音信息中，萨米娅说：

sentences.en: The parents that I cried for while I was away are mine no more.
sentences.zh: 我离家时为之痛哭的父母已经不再属于我了。

sentences.en: My kids will never see them, never hear them.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子将永远见不到他们，也永远听不到他们的声音。

sentences.en: I'm broken.
sentences.zh: 我心碎了。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样吧。

sentences.en: My only pride is you, and you alone.
sentences.zh: 我唯一的骄傲就是你，唯有你。

sentences.en: Samia returned to Dubai devastated.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅心灰意冷地回到了迪拜。

sentences.en: Ten months later, in June 2016, 28-year-old Samia was informed that her ex-husband's mother had passed away.
sentences.zh: 十个月后，即2016年6月，28岁的萨米娅接到通知，她前夫的母亲去世了。

sentences.en: As well as being Samia's former mother-in-law, she was also her aunt.
sentences.zh: 她不仅是萨米娅的前婆婆，也是她的姑妈。

sentences.en: The pair had been markedly close during Samia's time in Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 在萨米娅在巴基斯坦期间，两人关系极其亲密。

sentences.en: Samia desperately wanted to attend the funeral service in Pandori.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅迫切希望去潘多里参加葬礼。

sentences.en: Her parents and sister would also be there, granting her the opportunity to see them for the first time in almost a year.
sentences.zh: 她的父母和妹妹也会在那里，这为她提供了近一年来首次见到他们的机会。

sentences.en: However, the trip was fraught with risk.
sentences.zh: 然而，这次行程充满风险。

sentences.en: Threats and attacks made against Samia in the UK for her alleged blasphemy had been restrained by prevailing Western customs and British law.
sentences.zh: 由于西方风俗和英国法律的约束，英国境内针对萨米娅涉嫌亵渎神明所做出的威胁和袭击一直有所克制。

sentences.en: It was different in Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 巴基斯坦的情况则完全不同。

sentences.en: When a person brings shame upon their family, millennia-old Pakistani tradition dictates that honour can be restored by male family members murdering that person.
sentences.zh: 当一个人给家族带来耻辱时，延续千年的巴基斯坦传统规定，可以通过由男性家族成员谋杀该人来恢复荣誉。

sentences.en: In a society where some value the dominance of men and the modesty and subservience of women,
sentences.zh: 在一个将男性主导以及女性的端庄顺从奉为圭臬的社会里，

sentences.en: the majority of honour-killing victims are girls and women who are killed by male relatives.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数荣誉谋杀的受害者都是被男性亲属杀害的女孩和妇女。

sentences.en: In Pakistan, many actions can lead to family dishonour, including when a woman marries against her family's wishes.
sentences.zh: 在巴基斯坦，许多行为都会导致家族蒙羞，其中包括女性违背家人的意愿结婚。

sentences.en: Although forbidden under Sharia law, the practice of karokkari, or honour-killing, has continued in Pakistan, especially in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 尽管沙里亚法禁止这种行为，但卡罗卡里（即荣誉谋杀）的做法在巴基斯坦依然存在，特别是在农村地区。

sentences.en: Samia knew that travelling to Pakistan would put her life in danger.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅深知去巴基斯坦旅行会让她的生命处于危险之中。

sentences.en: Her ex-husband, Chaudhry Shaquille, still lived there, and he and his family would no doubt have strong feelings about Samia's perceived indiscretions.
sentences.zh: 她的前夫乔杜里·沙基尔依然住在那里，他和他的家人无疑对萨米娅被认为的越轨行为有着强烈的情绪。

sentences.en: After mulling it over with her husband Ali, Samia decided that it wasn't wise for her to go to Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 在与丈夫阿里反复斟酌后，萨米娅决定去巴基斯坦并不是明智之举。

sentences.en: Several days after her aunt's funeral, Samia received word from her mother and sister.
sentences.zh: 在姑妈的葬礼几天后，萨米娅收到了母亲和妹妹的消息。

sentences.en: While they were in Pakistan, Samia's father had suffered complications in relation to his diabetes.
sentences.zh: 当他们在巴基斯坦时，萨米娅的父亲糖尿病并发症发作。

sentences.en: His health had taken a turn for the worse, and they feared he didn't have much time left.
sentences.zh: 他的健康状况急转直下，他们担心他时日无多。

sentences.en: Samia's family encouraged her to visit him.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的家人鼓励她前去探望。

sentences.en: Despite the painful rejection, Samia still loved her father.
sentences.zh: 尽管承受着痛苦的拒绝，萨米娅依然爱着她的父亲。

sentences.en: Yet, she remained uncertain if Pakistan was safe for her.
sentences.zh: 然而，她仍然不确定巴基斯坦对她而言是否安全。

sentences.en: While Samia's husband and friends agreed that she would likely never forgive herself if her father died without her by his side,
sentences.zh: 虽然萨米娅的丈夫和朋友都认为，如果父亲临终前她没能在身边，她可能永远无法原谅自己，

sentences.en: they were adamant that she would be risking everything by returning to Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信，萨米娅回巴基斯坦将冒着失去一切的风险。

sentences.en: Samia made her decision.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅做出了决定。

sentences.en: Her sister booked her a plane ticket, and on Thursday July 14, 2016, Samia boarded her flight to Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 她的姐姐为她订了机票，2016年7月14日星期四，萨米娅登上了飞往巴基斯坦的航班。

sentences.en: Before she left, she messaged a friend, asking her to, quote,
sentences.zh: 在她离开之前，她给一位朋友发了一条消息，请她转述，原话是：

sentences.en: Pray I come back alive.
sentences.zh: 祈祷我能活着回来。

sentences.en: Samia's friend responded with one word.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的朋友只回复了一个词。

sentences.en: Inshah Allah.
sentences.zh: 因沙真主。

sentences.en: Meaning, God willing.
sentences.zh: 意思是，如果真主允许。

sentences.en: During her first night in Pakistan, Samia stayed with a friend.
sentences.zh: 在巴基斯坦的第一晚，萨米娅借住在一位朋友家。

sentences.en: She left her passport and return ticket at their house for safekeeping.
sentences.zh: 她把护照和回程机票留在他们家以妥善保管。

sentences.en: She then made her way to Pandori.
sentences.zh: 随后她动身前往潘多里。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, Samia sent several text messages to Ali, updating him on her plans and sending her love.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，萨米娅给阿里发了好几条短信，向他通报自己的计划并表达爱意。

sentences.en: She spent time with her mother, father and sister, as well as extended family.
sentences.zh: 她和母亲、父亲、姐姐以及其他亲属在一起度过了时光。

sentences.en: On July 18, Samia visited her aunt's grave with her father.
sentences.zh: 7月18日，萨米娅和父亲一起去拜祭了她姑姑的墓。

sentences.en: Around noon on Wednesday July 20, she went to the Pakistani bazaar to buy food for dinner.
sentences.zh: 7月20日星期三中午左右，她去了巴基斯坦集市买晚饭的食材。

sentences.en: She messaged Ali,
sentences.zh: 她给阿里发了一条消息，

sentences.en: About 90 minutes after Samia sent this message, the phone rang at the Pandori police station.
sentences.zh: 在萨米娅发出这条消息大约90分钟后，潘多里警察局的电话响了。

sentences.en: On the line was Mohammed Shahid.
sentences.zh: 打电话来的是穆罕默德·沙希德。

sentences.en: He was distressed and crying, and he informed the answering officer,
sentences.zh: 他情绪激动且在哭泣，他向接警警官通报说，

sentences.en: Police were directed to go to the home of Chaudhry Shaquille, where they found Samia Shahid lying motionless on her back at the foot of the stairs.
sentences.zh: 警方奉命前往乔杜里·沙基尔的住所，在那里他们发现萨米娅·沙希德毫无气息地仰面躺在楼梯脚下。

sentences.en: Her scarf was covering her face.
sentences.zh: 她的面部被围巾盖着。

sentences.en: Police lifted it away gently, revealing that Samia's eyes were closed and froth had formed around her mouth.
sentences.zh: 警察轻轻掀开围巾，发现萨米娅双目紧闭，口吐白沫。

sentences.en: She was clearly deceased.
sentences.zh: 她显然已经死亡。

sentences.en: Her slip-on shoes were scattered nearby and her handbag had been placed by her feet.
sentences.zh: 她的便鞋散落在附近，手提包被放在她的脚边。

sentences.en: Chaudhry Shaquille was not at the scene and no one knew where he had gone.
sentences.zh: 乔杜里·沙基尔不在现场，也没有人知道他去了哪里。

sentences.en: Later that evening, Ali Chasm received a phone call from Shaquille, who informed Ali that Samia had suffered a heart attack and died.
sentences.zh: 当天傍晚晚些时候，阿里·卡兹姆接到沙基尔打来的电话，沙基尔告诉阿里，萨米娅突发心脏病身亡。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: “案件档案”节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持“案件档案”继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Samia's friends in the UK started receiving mixed messages about her cause of death.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅在英国的朋友们开始收到关于她死因的各种矛盾说法。

sentences.en: Some were told she died of a heart attack or a severe asthma attack, while others heard she fell down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 有人被告知她死于心脏病发作或严重的哮喘发作，而另一些人则听说她从楼梯上摔了下来。

sentences.en: Neither Samia's friends nor husband believed any of these explanations for a second.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的朋友和丈夫都不相信这些解释哪怕一秒钟。

sentences.en: Within 72 hours of his wife's death, Ali Chasm flew to Pakistan to investigate the matter personally.
sentences.zh: 在妻子去世后的小时内，阿里·卡兹姆飞往巴基斯坦亲自调查此事。

sentences.en: He was immediately confronted with a significant problem.
sentences.zh: 他立即面临一个重大的问题。

sentences.en: If a death isn't contentious, Sharia law requires burial to be swift.
sentences.zh: 如果死因没有争议，伊斯兰教法要求迅速下葬。

sentences.en: Allegedly, there were no visible injuries or signs of violence on Samia's body.
sentences.zh: 据称，萨米娅的尸体上没有可见的伤痕或暴力迹象。

sentences.en: Therefore, police did not view her death as suspicious.
sentences.zh: 因此，警方并不认为她的死有什么可疑之处。

sentences.en: Her body was hastily released to her family and within hours of her death,
sentences.zh: 她的遗体匆忙移交给家属，在她死后短短几小时内，

sentences.en: Samia had been buried in the village cemetery.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅就已经被安葬在村里的公墓里。

sentences.en: Ali informed officers at Pandori's local police station of the threats and attacks levelled against his wife as a result of their marriage.
sentences.zh: 阿里向潘多里当地警察局的警官通报了由于他们的婚姻而对妻子发出的威胁和袭击。

sentences.en: With these new insights, officers considered the possibility that Samia was the victim of a karokari, an honour killing.
sentences.zh: 根据这些新线索，警官们开始考虑萨米娅是卡罗卡里（即荣誉谋杀）受害者的可能性。

sentences.en: In the UK, Samia's friends worked diligently to raise awareness of Samia's death, which they undoubtedly believed was a murder.
sentences.zh: 在英国，萨米娅的朋友们努力提高人们对萨米娅之死的认识，他们坚信这是一起谋杀案。

sentences.en: News of the case reached the local Member of Parliament for Samia's constituency of West
sentences.zh: 该案的消息传到了萨米娅所在选区西

sentences.en: Bradford, Naz Shah.
sentences.zh: 布拉德福德的国会议员纳兹·沙赫那里。

sentences.en: Like Samia, Naz Shah was a British citizen of Pakistani descent and she immediately recognised that Samia's death had all the attributes of an honour killing.
sentences.zh: 与萨米娅一样，纳兹·沙赫也是具有巴基斯坦血统的英国公民，她一眼就看出萨米娅的死具备荣誉谋杀的一切特征。

sentences.en: She wasted no time writing to the Pakistani Prime Minister seeking a proper investigation into
sentences.zh: 她毫不耽误地写信给巴基斯坦总理，要求对

sentences.en: Samia's death.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的死进行彻底调查。

sentences.en: As a result, Naz Shah started receiving threats from the Shahid family in Bradford.
sentences.zh: 因此，纳兹·沙赫开始收到来自布拉德福德沙希德家族的威胁。

sentences.en: Two of Samia's relatives, a 32-year-old woman and a 37-year-old male, were arrested.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅的两名亲属，一名32岁的女性和一名37岁的男性被捕。

sentences.en: In Pakistan, Ali Khazm got his hands on a copy of Samia's autopsy report.
sentences.zh: 在巴基斯坦，阿里·哈兹姆拿到了一份萨米娅的尸检报告副本。

sentences.en: The contents shocked him and he quickly arranged a press conference in order to announce the truth of his findings.
sentences.zh: 报告的内容让他震惊，他迅速安排了一场新闻发布会，以公布其调查结果的真相。

sentences.en: A 19-centimetre-long reddish-brown bruise had been found around Samia's neck.
sentences.zh: 在萨米娅的脖子周围发现了一处长达19厘米的红褐色淤青。

sentences.en: The cause of her death had been listed as asphyxia.
sentences.zh: 她的死因被列为窒息。

sentences.en: Photographs showing this bruise were leaked to the media.
sentences.zh: 显示这处淤青的照片被泄露给了媒体。

sentences.en: Ali remained in Pakistan determined to find out what exactly had happened to his wife.
sentences.zh: 阿里留在巴基斯坦，决心查明他的妻子到底发生了什么事。

sentences.en: His efforts resulted in death threats, with Ali subsequently requiring 24-hour police protection.
sentences.zh: 他的努力招来了死亡威胁，阿里随后需要24小时的警方保护。

sentences.en: The rising political pressure resulted in a special task force being established to investigate
sentences.zh: 不断上升的政治压力促使成立了一个特别工作组来调查

sentences.en: Samia Shahid's death.
sentences.zh: 萨米娅·沙希德的死因。

sentences.en: In mid-August, weeks after she died, the task force tracked down Chaudhry Shaquille.
sentences.zh: 八月中旬，在她去世几周后，工作组找到了乔杜里·沙基尔。

sentences.en: During interrogation, Shaquille revealed that the morning before Samia was due to depart Pakistan, he rummaged through her belongings in search of her passport and flight ticket.
sentences.zh: 在审讯期间，沙基尔透露，在萨米娅预定离开巴基斯坦的当天早晨，他在她的行李中翻找她的护照和机票。

sentences.en: Unable to find them, he confronted Samia and tried to pressure her to remain in Pakistan with him.
sentences.zh: 由于找不到，他与萨米娅对质，并试图向她施压，让她留在巴基斯坦陪他。

sentences.en: When she refused, Shaquille raped her.
sentences.zh: 当她拒绝时，沙基尔强奸了她。

sentences.en: Traces of seminal fluid inside Samia's body were found to match Shaquille.
sentences.zh: 经查，萨米娅体内的精液痕迹与沙基尔相符。

sentences.en: After her ordeal, Samia tried to run out of the house.
sentences.zh: 经历这场劫难后，萨米娅试图跑出屋外。

sentences.en: But Shaquille chased her down and strangled her to death with her own scarf.
sentences.zh: 但沙基尔追上了她，并用她自己的围巾将她勒死。

sentences.en: Shaquille was adamant that he had acted alone, but police weren't convinced.
sentences.zh: 沙基尔坚称他是独自行动的，但警方并不信服。

sentences.en: When they arrived at Shaquille's home the day Samia was killed, they were met with Muhammad Shahid.
sentences.zh: 当萨米娅遇害当天他们到达沙基尔家时，迎接他们的是穆罕默德·沙希德。

sentences.en: He outright told police that his daughter had died of a heart attack and kept this story up until Ali Qasim held his press conference revealing Samia's autopsy results.
sentences.zh: 他直接告诉警察他的女儿死于心脏病发作，并一直坚持这种说法，直到阿里·卡西姆举行新闻发布会公布了萨米娅的尸检结果。

sentences.en: Muhammad then revised his previous statements to say that Samia had suicided.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德随后修改了他先前的陈述，称萨米娅是自杀的。

sentences.en: Muhammad had told police at the scene that Samia was married to and lived with Chaudhry Shaquille.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德在现场曾告诉警察，萨米娅嫁给了乔杜里·沙基尔并与他同住。

sentences.en: He made no mention of Ali Qasim at the time, later claiming that he had never even heard of Ali.
sentences.zh: 他当时没有提及阿里·卡西姆，后来声称他甚至从未听说过阿里。

sentences.en: With his story failing to add up, Muhammad Shahid was taken into custody, believed to have at least been an accessory to his daughter's murder.
sentences.zh: 由于他的说辞前后矛盾，穆罕默德·沙希德被拘留，被认为至少是他女儿谋杀案的从犯。

sentences.en: According to a 43-page report prepared by the Special Investigation Task Force, Samia Shahid was the victim of a premeditated and cold-blooded honour killing.
sentences.zh: 根据特别调查工作组准备的一份长达43页的报告，萨米娅·沙希德是一起有预谋的冷血荣誉谋杀的受害者。

sentences.en: Her family had felt disrespected by her attempt to divorce Chaudhry Shaquille and were further dishonoured when Samia instead married a man who wasn't a Sunni Muslim.
sentences.zh: 她的家人对她试图与乔杜里·沙基尔离婚感到被冒犯，而当萨米娅转而嫁给一个不是逊尼派穆斯林的男人时，他们更觉颜面尽失。

sentences.en: Shaquille was also angry that he could no longer immigrate to England as Samia's spouse.
sentences.zh: 沙基尔也很生气，因为他不能再作为萨米娅的配偶移民到英国。

sentences.en: The report highlighted the campaign of threats against Samia over the preceding years and the trepidation that she must have felt in returning to Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 报告强调了过去几年针对萨米娅的威胁运动以及她在返回巴基斯坦时必然感到的恐惧。

sentences.en: Investigators believed that Muhammad Shahid and Chaudhry Shaquille had always intended to bring Samia back to Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，穆罕默德·沙希德和乔杜里·沙基尔一直打算把萨米娅带回巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: They likely intended to persuade or otherwise force her to resume her marriage to Shaquille.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能是想劝说或以其他方式迫使她恢复与沙基尔的婚姻。

sentences.en: When she refused and tried to escape Shaquille's home, Samia was likely confronted by her father.
sentences.zh: 当她拒绝并试图逃离沙基尔的家时，萨米娅很可能遇到了她的父亲。

sentences.en: It was believed he had held Samia's legs while Shaquille strangled her with her own scarf.
sentences.zh: 据信他按住了萨米娅的腿，而沙基尔则用她自己的围巾勒死了她。

sentences.en: After the murder, Shaquille fled while Samia's father did everything he could to hide the truth from first responders.
sentences.zh: 谋杀发生后，沙基尔逃跑了，而萨米娅的父亲则竭尽全力向急救人员隐瞒真相。

sentences.en: The task force believed that Muhammad Shahid knew that the post-mortem results would reveal that his daughter had been strangled.
sentences.zh: 工作组相信穆罕默德·沙希德知道尸检结果会显示他的女儿是被勒死的。

sentences.en: If those results were leaked, they believed that Muhammad Shahid had a backup plan to lodge his own private prosecution against Shaquille for murder.
sentences.zh: 如果这些结果被泄露，他们认为穆罕默德·沙希德有一个备用计划，即以谋杀罪对沙基尔提起自己的私人诉讼。

sentences.en: Deeply rooted in Islamic law and codified by Pakistani's penal code is the concept of retributive justice, known as kassass.
sentences.zh: 深深植根于伊斯兰法并被巴基斯坦刑法编纂成文的是同态复仇的概念，被称为卡萨斯。

sentences.en: However, it is possible to circumvent such an eye-for-an-eye approach through a diet, a payment in lieu of punishment.
sentences.zh: 然而，可以通过“血价”（即代替惩罚的赔偿金）来绕过这种以牙还牙的方法。

sentences.en: Muhammad Shahid would have been able to renounce his right to have his daughter's killer sent to prison, or possibly executed,
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·沙希德本可以放弃将女儿的杀手送进监狱甚至处决的权利，

sentences.en: if the killer instead paid him financial compensation.
sentences.zh: 如果凶手向他支付经济赔偿的话。

sentences.en: This loophole is often utilised in honour killings.
sentences.zh: 这个漏洞经常被利用于荣誉谋杀中。

sentences.en: Muhammad and Chaudhry Shaquille likely planned to use these, quote, blood money laws to pardon Shaquille for killing Samia.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德和乔杜里·沙基尔很可能计划利用这些所谓的“血钱”法律来赦免沙基尔杀害萨米娅的罪行。

sentences.en: The task force report noted that the collusion between Shaquille and Muhammad Shahid was almost the perfect plot.
sentences.zh: 工作组报告指出，沙基尔与穆罕默德·沙希德之间的勾结几乎是一个完美的阴谋。

sentences.en: Had it not been for Ali Qasim's immediate determination to uncover the truth, they would have gotten away with murder.
sentences.zh: 要不是阿里·卡西姆立即要查明真相的决心，他们早就逃脱谋杀罪责了。

sentences.en: Muhammad Shahid and Chaudhry Shaquille applied for bail at each preliminary hearing in the district court.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·沙希德和乔杜里·沙基尔在地区法院的每次初步听证会上都申请保释。

sentences.en: They were denied each time.
sentences.zh: 他们每次都被拒绝。

sentences.en: After four months in jail, Muhammad appealed to the High Court of Lahore.
sentences.zh: 在狱中呆了四个月后，穆罕默德向拉合尔高等法院提起上诉。

sentences.en: The judges determined that there wasn't enough evidence against him to justify his continued custody.
sentences.zh: 法官裁定，没有足够的证据支持继续对其实施关押。

sentences.en: The state prosecutor appealed to Pakistan's Supreme Court, however the court upheld the ruling.
sentences.zh: 国家检察官向巴基斯坦最高法院提起上诉，然而法院维持了原判。

sentences.en: Muhammad Shahid was released.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·沙希德被释放了。

sentences.en: The case against Chaudhry Shaquille was much stronger, but not watertight.
sentences.zh: 针对乔杜里·沙基尔的案件要强得多，但也并非万无一失。

sentences.en: In Pakistan, confessions made outside of a court of law have no legal standing and cannot be used as evidence against an accused.
sentences.zh: 在巴基斯坦，在法庭之外做出的供述不具有法律效力，不能用作指控被告的证据。

sentences.en: This practice is designed to eliminate the risk of coerced confessions.
sentences.zh: 这一做法旨在消除逼供的风险。

sentences.en: Shaquille remained in custody, albeit without formal charges being laid.
sentences.zh: 沙基尔仍被关押，尽管尚未正式提出指控。

sentences.en: By the time the one-year anniversary of Samia Shahid's murder approached, no tangible progress had been made towards a trial.
sentences.zh: 随着萨米娅·沙希德遇害一周年纪念日的临近，审判方面没有取得任何实质性进展。

sentences.en: In response to the slow-turning wheels of justice, Bradford West Member of Parliament Naz Shah once again wrote to the Pakistani Prime Minister,
sentences.zh: 针对迟缓的司法车轮，布拉德福德西区国会议员纳兹·沙赫再次写信给巴基斯坦总理，

sentences.en: urging him to pursue justice for Samia.
sentences.zh: 敦促他为萨米娅伸张正义。

sentences.en: Naz Shah received the appropriate assurances, but still nothing seemed to be done.
sentences.zh: 纳兹·沙赫得到了适当的保证，但似乎仍然什么都没做。

sentences.en: Six months later, in late January 2018, Muhammad Shahid was hospitalised.
sentences.zh: 六个月后，即2018年1月底，穆罕默德·沙希德住院了。

sentences.en: He succumbed to kidney failure and passed away.
sentences.zh: 他因肾衰竭去世。

sentences.en: Neither Muhammad's wife, Imtiaz Bibi, nor his daughter, Madiha, were at his side when he died.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德的妻子英蒂亚兹·比比和女儿马迪哈在他去世时都不在他身边。

sentences.en: A warrant was out for their arrest in Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 巴基斯坦已对她们发出逮捕令。

sentences.en: The task force fronting the investigation into Samia Shahid's murder had reviewed the possibility of others being involved.
sentences.zh: 负责调查萨米娅·沙希德谋杀案的工作组曾审查过其他人牵涉其中的可能性。

sentences.en: They had come to believe that Samia's mother and sister played some ancillary role in Samia's death.
sentences.zh: 他们开始相信萨米娅的母亲和姐姐在萨米娅的死中起到了某种辅助作用。

sentences.en: But when they tried to bring them in for further questioning, they discovered that both women had fled back to the UK.
sentences.zh: 但当他们试图传唤她们进行进一步讯问时，他们发现这两个女人都已经逃回了英国。

sentences.en: In 2018, Samia's sister, Madiha, granted an exclusive interview with British tabloid Asian Express.
sentences.zh: 2018年，萨米娅的姐姐马迪哈接受了英国小报《亚洲快报》的独家采访。

sentences.en: In the interview, she expressed her family's ongoing belief that Samia's marriage to Chaudry Shaquille was legal and not forced.
sentences.zh: 在采访中，她表达了其家人一贯的信念，即萨米娅与乔杜里·沙基尔的婚姻是合法的，并非强迫。

sentences.en: Madiha said that she and her family were emotionally torn and couldn't understand Samia's sudden death.
sentences.zh: 马迪哈表示，她和家人内心痛苦交织，无法理解萨米娅的突然离世。

sentences.en: She referred to it as a tragic accident, while claiming the photographs showing the strangulation mark around her sister's neck were fake.
sentences.zh: 她称这是一场悲惨的事故，同时声称显示她姐姐脖子上勒痕的照片是伪造的。

sentences.en: Madiha proclaimed that she and her family were innocent and that their lives had been ruined by, quote,
sentences.zh: 马迪哈宣称她和家人是清白的，他们的生活被，原话是，

sentences.en: a false narrative calling this an honour killing from the outset.
sentences.zh: “从一开始就把这称为荣誉谋杀的虚假叙事”给彻底毁了。

sentences.en: Imtiaz Bibi and Madiha Shahid are still wanted for questioning by Pakistani authorities.
sentences.zh: 巴基斯坦当局仍在通缉英蒂亚兹·比比和马迪哈·沙希德进行讯问。

sentences.en: Investigators also found evidence implicating local police officer Mohamed Akil Abbas in covering up the crime.
sentences.zh: 调查人员还发现了暗示当地警官穆罕默德·阿基尔·阿巴斯掩盖犯罪行为的证据。
zh_words: 穆罕默德·阿基尔·阿巴斯

sentences.en: Abbas was one of the first officers on the scene after Samia's death.
sentences.zh: 阿巴斯是萨米娅死后首批到达现场的警官之一。

sentences.en: It is alleged that he had accepted a bribe from Chaudry Shaquille in order to let him flee the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 据称他接受了乔杜里·沙基尔的贿赂，以便让他逃离犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Abbas had also concealed the presence of the large strangulation mark around Samia's neck.
sentences.zh: 阿巴斯还隐瞒了萨米娅颈部周围有巨大勒痕的情况。

sentences.en: Additionally, he'd helped Samia's mother and sister leave Pakistan, despite specific instructions from his superiors not to let them go.
sentences.zh: 此外，尽管上司有明确指示不准放行，他还是协助萨米娅的母亲和姐姐离开了巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: Eleven weeks after Samia's murder, the Pakistan parliament passed a bill to close the blood money legal loophole with regard to honour killings.
sentences.zh: 在萨米娅遇害十一周后，巴基斯坦议会通过了一项法案，堵住了荣誉谋杀方面的“血钱”法律漏洞。

sentences.en: The new bill amended the Pakistan penal code so that the family of an honour killing victim could no longer entirely forgive the perpetrator on receipt of financial compensation.
sentences.zh: 新法案修改了巴基斯坦刑法，规定荣誉谋杀受害者的家属在收到经济赔偿后，不再能完全原谅凶手。

sentences.en: Instead, the perpetrator would face a mandatory life sentence.
sentences.zh: 相反，凶手将面临强制性的无期徒刑。

sentences.en: In September 2018, after having spent two years in police custody without charge, Chaudry Shaquille was released on bail.
sentences.zh: 2018年9月，在未经指控被警方关押两年后，乔杜里·沙基尔获得保释。

sentences.en: He was permitted to live freely within his community while awaiting trial.
sentences.zh: 在等待审判期间，他被允许在社区内自由生活。

sentences.en: A year later, Shaquille remarried.
sentences.zh: 一年后，沙基尔再婚。

sentences.en: Like Samia, his wife was British-Pakistani, and Shaquille once again applied to immigrate to the UK under a spousal visa.
sentences.zh: 和萨米娅一样，他的妻子也是英籍巴基斯坦人，沙基尔再次申请以配偶签证移民英国。

sentences.en: Bradford West Member of Parliament Naz Shah again wrote to the Pakistan Prime Minister, as well as the British Home and Foreign Secretaries.
sentences.zh: 布拉德福德西区国会议员纳兹·沙赫再次写信给巴基斯坦总理以及英国内政大臣和外交大臣。

sentences.en: She labelled the potential for Shaquille to be allowed entry into the UK as extremely worrying and potentially dangerous.
sentences.zh: 她将允许沙基尔入境英国的可能性标记为极其令人担忧且具有潜在危险。

sentences.en: Shaquille's application was unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 沙基尔的申请没有成功。

sentences.en: Every year since, Naz Shah renewed her appeals to both British and Pakistani authorities to encourage progress in the case against Shaquille.
sentences.zh: 此后每年，纳兹·沙赫都向英国和巴基斯坦当局重申她的呼吁，以推动针对沙基尔案件的进展。

sentences.en: Promises have been made, but no action has been taken.
sentences.zh: 承诺已经做出，但没有采取任何行动。

sentences.en: In July 2022, six years after Samia's murder, Naz Shah posted online.
sentences.zh: 2022年7月，在萨米娅遇害六年之后，纳兹·沙赫在网上发帖。

sentences.en: Sadly, after years of fighting for this case, I think there is little hope that the justice system in Pakistan will ever give Samia the justice she deserves.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，在为这个案件斗争了多年之后，我认为巴基斯坦的司法系统几乎没有希望给萨米娅她应得的正义。
